exposure: gastrointestinal system cancer diagnosis during pregnancy
cohort: 9,096,788 women who delivered or had a maternal death in the US between 2004 and 2014
finding: Women with a diagnosis of GIS cancer in pregnancy had a higher incidence of maternal complications, including maternal death, and a lower rate of spontaneous vaginal delivery and a higher rate of preterm delivery, but no differences in neonatal outcomes compared to women without GIS cancer.
